lines.zh: 雷蟒滑过潮湿地面的落叶
lines.en: Thunder Boa slides over the wet leaf litter.

lines.zh: 它的身体像一道弯曲的闪电
lines.en: Its body curves like a bent lightning bolt.
It rounds a root without a sound.

lines.zh: 鳞片擦过地面，沙沙轻响
lines.en: Scales rasp the ground, softly.

lines.zh: 它把头抬到与你胸口齐高
lines.en: Its head rises to your chest height.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴在后面慢慢跟上
lines.en: Its tail follows slowly behind.

lines.zh: 它贴着树干往上走了一小段
lines.en: It climbs a short way up a trunk.
It slides past a puddle's edge.

lines.zh: 它的动作没有一丝停顿
lines.en: Its motion has no pauses.

lines.zh: 它沿着林间一条湿痕前进
lines.en: It follows a wet trail through the trees.

lines.zh: 它在你面前横过一小段
lines.en: It crosses in front of you briefly.

lines.zh: 雨水顺着它的鳞流下来
lines.en: Rain runs down its scales.

lines.zh: 雷蟒盘在树根间，很安静
lines.en: Thunder Boa coils among roots, quiet.
Its head rests on its own coils.

lines.zh: 它把舌头吐出来又收回去
lines.en: It flicks its tongue out and back.
Its scales shine in the rain.
It coils up and breathes slowly.

lines.zh: 地上它身下的叶子被压平
lines.en: Leaves flatten under its coils.
It lifts its head to listen to rain.
Its tail tip twitches.

lines.zh: 它缓缓挪动了一小段身体
lines.en: It shifts a short length of itself.

lines.zh: 它看起来像一截湿木头
lines.en: It looks like a wet log.
Thunder Boa turns its head to you.
It raises a little of itself.

lines.zh: 舌头伸出来闻了闻空气
lines.en: Its tongue tests the air.
It measures you from end to end.
It does not move at once.
It starts circling you.
Its eyes do not blink.
Its head comes near your knee.
Then it draws back.
It seems in no hurry to decide.
Thunder Boa springs back.
It coils up tight.
A scale comes loose.
It presses its head low.
Its tongue flicks fast.
It retreats behind a root.
Its breathing turns shallow.
It slowly raises its head again.

lines.zh: 它的身体还有一半没动
lines.en: Half its body has not moved.
It does not leave, only grows warier.

lines.zh: 雷蟒朝你手里的肉来了
lines.en: Thunder Boa comes for the meat.
Its head reaches over, slowly.
It bites and shakes its head.
It swallows the meat whole.

lines.zh: 喉咙鼓了一下，又瘪下去
lines.en: Its throat bulges and smooths.
It looks up for a second piece.
It coils by your feet and waits.

lines.zh: 它对不合口的东西不碰
lines.en: What it dislikes, it leaves alone.

lines.zh: 它把下巴搁在你的靴子上
lines.en: It rests its chin on your boot.
Its tongue keeps flicking.
You kick Thunder Boa and it slides free.
It coils fast and its head comes up.
It tightens beside your foot.
Its scales scrape your shoe.
It pulls back a foot and stops.

lines.zh: 它把你的腿当成树根绕了半圈
lines.en: It takes your leg for a root and half-wraps it.
It slowly loosens and slides aside.
It flicks up a little rain.
Its head dips back to the ground.
As if it were only passing.
Two thunder boas twine together.

lines.zh: 它们的鳞色在雨里都很暗
lines.en: Both their hides are dark in the rain.
Their heads come together.
They turn slowly around one another.
Their bodies overlap in a heap.

lines.zh: 它们安静得像一块湿石
lines.en: They lie still as wet stone.

lines.zh: 雨落在它们身上，谁都没动
lines.en: Rain falls on them; neither stirs.
The two snakes breathe in one beat.
Long after, they separate.
Each slides off to a different root.
Thunder Boa takes the food.
It swallows it whole.
A bulge moves down its throat.
What it rejects, it spits out.

lines.zh: 它把东西绕在身体中间
lines.en: It coils around the item.
It sniffs before eating.

lines.zh: 它把剩下的留给身后的同伴
lines.en: It leaves the rest for its companion.
Afterward it licks its mouth.
It slides slowly toward the roots.

lines.zh: 它把身体盘在食物上方
lines.en: It coils over the food.
Thunder Boa's head snaps up.
Its body bends into an arc.
It starts sliding toward you.
Its tongue flicks rapidly.

lines.zh: 它把地面上的落叶推开
lines.en: It pushes the fallen leaves aside.

lines.zh: 它的速度比刚才快了很多
lines.en: It is much faster than before.
It has looped across your exit.
Its eyes fix on you.
Its head lowers an inch.
Muscle swells beneath the scales.
Its body gathers into an S.

lines.zh: 它一瞬间就不见了草里
lines.en: In a blink it is gone into the grass.
Then it appears behind you.
It draws its tail in too.

lines.zh: 它已经找到出手的角度
lines.en: It has found its angle.
Its head sinks, ready to strike.
Thunder Boa tightens its circle.
Its body slides low on the ground.
Two loops, and it does not stop.
It waits for your foot to land.
Its head stays aimed at you.

lines.zh: 它忽然静止，像一段绳子
lines.en: It goes still as a length of rope.
Then it shifts once.

lines.zh: 它把身体缠上旁边的树
lines.en: It winds part of itself around a tree.
From up there it brings its head back.
Its shadow moves across your feet.

lines.zh: 它试着缩短最后一点距离
lines.en: It tries to close the last of the gap.
Rain parts around its body.
Its jaw hangs very slightly open.

lines.zh: 它数着你的呼吸，风暴林里雷声压着。
lines.en: It counts your breaths under the storm jungle thunder.
You retreat; it presses forward.
The loop has closed to your feet.
It begins winding up your calf.
Its head rises past your knee.
It could strike at any moment.
Its body pulls taut as a bowstring.

lines.zh: 雷蟒一口咬在你的腿上
lines.en: Thunder Boa bites your leg.
Its whole body launches at you.
It wraps your calf and cinches.
Its head slams onto your chest.
It grips your sleeve and wrenches.
Its tail tip lashes your back.
It strikes down from the tree.

lines.zh: 它的身体在你腰上收了一圈
lines.en: It takes a loop around your waist.
It misses; its teeth click.
It backs a foot and recoils.

lines.zh: 它的鳞在你皮肤上刮过
lines.en: Its scales scrape your skin.

lines.zh: 它绕着你转，找下一个角度
lines.en: It circles, hunting the next angle.
It strikes from the side.
It tightens, then releases.
Its head comes up again.

lines.zh: 它的舌头在你脸边吐了吐
lines.en: Its tongue flicks by your face.
It slides slowly back into the grass.
But its head still points at you.
It has only changed position.
And then it comes again.
A shape slides through the grass.
Thunder Boa emerges from under the leaves.
It raises its head into the air.
Rain runs down its scales.
It coils into a ring.
Its tongue tests the air.
It begins to slide forward.

lines.zh: 枯叶在它身下发出细响
lines.en: Dry leaves whisper under it.

lines.zh: 它绕过一棵树，出现在空地
lines.en: It rounds a tree into the clearing.

lines.zh: 它的身体在雨里显得更长
lines.en: In the rain its body looks even longer.
It stops, head aimed at you.
It makes no sound at all.

lines.zh: 鳞被烫得卷起，它猛地抽身
lines.en: Heat curls its scales; it whips away.

lines.zh: 摔在地上，它摊开又盘起
lines.en: It hits the ground, sprawls, and coils.

lines.zh: 水里它扭得厉害，却上不去
lines.en: In water it writhes but cannot rise.
The blast throws it out in an arc.

lines.zh: 箭钉穿它的身体，把它按在地上
lines.en: An arrow pins it to the ground.
Odd force makes it clench all over.

lines.zh: 饿得没力气盘紧，身体发软
lines.en: Too starved to coil tight, its body slackens.

lines.zh: 雷击顺着鳞走，它浑身一颤
lines.en: Lightning runs its scales; it shudders.

lines.zh: 虚空吸住它，它往深处滑
lines.en: The void takes it and it slides into the dark.
